A confined ideal gas undergoes a cyclical process in three steps—an isobaric step, followed by an isochoric step, followed by an isothermal step. Which of the following must be true?
Option A: The change in internal energy of the gas is equal to the work done during the isobaric step.
Option B: The change in internal energy of the gas is equal to the work done during the isobaric step minus the work done during the isothermal step.
Option C: The total work done during the cycle is positive.
Option D: The total work done during the cycle is equal but opposite to the net amount of heat transferred.
